dict.string: vibe-sec scans Documents for .env files and API keys that may have been accidentally exposed. Everything stays on your Mac — nothing is sent anywhere.
vibe-sec checks Downloads for API key files (e.g. service account JSON) that may have been saved insecurely. Everything stays on your Mac — nothing is sent anywhere.
vibe-sec scans Desktop for .env files and credentials that may be exposed. Everything stays on your Mac — nothing is sent anywhere.
